The name is believed to invokes her blessings of abundance, prosperity, and success. It is a reminder of the divine power that can help overcome difficulties and bring success in all endeavors. The name Baraiya is a powerful reminder of the interconnectedness of the material and spiritual worlds and the importance of seeking prosperity and abundance in both aspects of life.
